artworks.title: Twilight (Le Crépuscule)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image features blurred lines and curves creating an abstract composition. Some shapes suggest a figure emerging from fog, with indistinct lines and smudges resembling an ethereal presence.

artworks.title: The Great Jewish Bride
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated from the waist up, in a slightly angled position towards the left. The individual has prominent facial features with a serene expression, including a broad nose and full lips. They have long, wavy hair cascading down their back, with some framing their face. The person is dressed in a voluminous textured garment, possibly fur-lined, with intricate patterns visible on the sleeves and collar. They hold a partially unrolled scroll in their right hand, while their left hand rests beside them. The background features a dark and detailed setting with a large stone arch or structure contributing to the ambiance.

artworks.title: Ruins of the Château Saint-Chamond, Loire
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a stone structure with a cylindrical tower. The viewpoint is from the ground level facing the structure. The walls are crumbling, and the stonework texture is visible. The horizon is not clear, with a gentle slope on the left. The etching uses fine lines and cross-hatching. The color scheme is monochrome. A figure holding a staff is on the left near an entrance. In the distance, the partially ruined wall continues, with plants growing from the cracks.

artworks.title: Two Houses with Tile Roofs
artworks.description: The image displays a ground-level perspective of a rustic structure within a natural landscape. The horizon and distant trees are positioned above the building's roofline. The structure includes a balcony and a sloped roof with a chimney emitting smoke. The scene suggests a rural setting surrounded by dense foliage. The etched lines feature fine detail outlining textures of brickwork, wood, and vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown, highlighting the intricate details. Details like a wooden fence and rocks under the building are depicted close by, while distant trees fade with intricately detailed lines. The overall scene conveys the tranquil atmosphere of a countryside dwelling in nature.

artworks.title: The Spring at l'Orsière
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with an arched stone structure resembling an old well or spring house. It is surrounded by foliage and trees that cover much of the top portion. The horizon is indicated by the undulating line of the terrain and vegetation. The engraving technique creates texture, especially in the plants and stonework. A stone trough or basin is nearby, part of the water feature. The color palette is sepia and brown, giving a vintage and earthy feel. The brushstrokes and shading create a rich textural quality.

artworks.title: The Spinner
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed rural scene with an elevated viewpoint. Two figures are near a rustic building with a textured roof and a fence. Trees frame the setting, which gently slopes downward towards a hazy horizon. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing sepia tones and shadows for depth. Fine linework and hatching convey texture and shading.

artworks.title: Ancient Tower with a Water Mill
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a river, a building with a water wheel, a man with a staff standing next to a goat, and trees in the background. The man's shadow is visible on the ground, creating texture. The building has a circular turret and detailed stone masonry. The artwork is characterized by fine etchings and a monochromatic color palette of black and cream tones. In the distance, trees create a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Standing Saint with a Crucifix and a Book
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person from the torso up, seated and turned slightly to the right. The facial features, beard, and hair are depicted with lines and shading. The clothing is loosely drawn with flowing lines. The individual holds a stick or staff in one hand and rests their other arm on something. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Male Herm
artworks.medium: charcoal and white heightening on tan paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person from the waist up. The person is in a pose with both arms raised above their head, showing the torso. The face is slightly tilted upward in a profile view with defined facial features and curly hair. The person is not clothed, highlighting the body's contours, musculature, and shading. There are no accessories or visible objects, and the background is minimalistic, emphasizing the central figure through shading and lines.

artworks.title: The Lamentation with Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dynamic and complex scene with multiple figures. The drawing is characterized by loose, expressive lines suggesting movement and a congregation of figures. The scene depicts figures in sweeping, gestural motions, with elements suggesting drapery or garments. The drawing is rendered in a monochromatic palette, using ink on paper, giving it a sketch-like quality. The composition is semicircular at the top. The figures display a sense of drama and emotion through their fluid and dynamic postures. The use of vigorous line work and shading gives the piece a sense of depth and vitality.

artworks.title: Christ Fallen on the Cross
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of intertwined figures engaged in a battle or struggle. The drawing is executed in rapid, expressive pen and ink lines, depicting groups of figures in motion, some carrying weapons like swords or spears. These figures are densely packed, creating a sense of turmoil and frenetic energy. On the left side, a figure is stretched horizontally on the ground beneath others in movement. On the right side, the composition continues with a tangle of figures in a similar chaotic arrangement. The use of lines and hatching suggests movement and aggression, creating a dramatic composition with a raw, unfinished quality.

artworks.title: A Wayside Shrine Carved into a Rocky Tor
artworks.description: The image displays a rocky landscape with scattered trees and a path leading to a rock formation with a religious icon. Fine pencil strokes depict detailed textures of foliage and rocks, with a monochrome palette of varying shades of gray creating depth and realism.

artworks.title: Joshua and the Israelites before the Walls of Jericho
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient procession with a prominent building in the background. The image shows a group of figures engaged in a procession, carrying an ornate object. They are adorned in classical drapery and armor. The background features a fortified city or castle with towers and battlements on a hill. The figures are shown in dynamic poses, with one in the foreground leading the procession and others behind them. The monochromatic palette and detailing in the architecture and figures suggest a historical or ceremonial narrative.

artworks.title: Silenus Accompanied by a Satyr and a Faun
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows three intertwined full-body figures. Each figure is muscular, bare-chested, with flowing hair. The central figure has a beard, while the others have curly hair. They are surrounded by a landscape with plants, rocks, and a cloudy sky with birds. The composition suggests movement and engagement with the surroundings.

artworks.title: Darius Receiving Water from the Helmet of One of Alexander's Soldiers
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a serene rural scene. The intricate composition includes a large ox or bull lying down with a wooden yoke around its neck. The animal appears to be resting in a field, surrounded by lush foliage and soft undulating terrain in the background. Next to the animal, at the left side of the drawing, cloth or fabric is draped, creating an area that appears cushioned or soft. The use of fine lines and cross-hatching gives the scene a detailed texture, emphasizing the various elements within the landscape. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, with an emphasis on rural life.

artworks.title: Travelers beside a Ruined Portico
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a classical structure with tall columns, viewed from a low angle. The scene includes a man and a dog exploring the ruins. The sky features dramatic clouds and light beams. The composition is detailed using hatching and cross-hatching techniques, with a color palette of beige and brown.

artworks.title: Horse and Rider at a Fountain
artworks.description: The image shows a person on horseback next to a round stone water basin, with architectural elements of a building visible on the left. Low-lying clouds and horizontal lines in the sky suggest the horizon. The artwork features intricate brushwork with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating texture in the sky, trees, and surfaces. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and tan. A sheep is curled up near the basin, and branches with leaves add movement to the composition.

artworks.title: Goats before Ruins and a Pyramid
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view of ancient ruins with weathered columns and a pyramid in the distance. The horizon is placed towards the middle of the composition, emphasizing the pyramid against the sky. The style features fine lines and cross-hatching to convey texture and depth in the stone surfaces and sky filled with clouds. The color palette is monochromatic with brown and beige tones. Remnants of a collapsed structure and scattered vegetation are seen nearby, enhancing the historical decay, while the distant pyramid adds mystery and grandeur.

artworks.title: Dogs Pursuing a Cat
artworks.description: The image shows architectural ruins and monkeys. Some monkeys are interacting with broken stone structures, including elements of classical architecture. The horizon features more ruins with sparse vegetation. Cloud formations are visible in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia or brown, consistent with an engraving technique.

artworks.title: Shepherds Traveling past a Ruined Rotunda
artworks.description: This image shows a view of a natural landscape combined with an architectural ruin. In the foreground, there are two ancient columns with carvings, overgrown with vines and vegetation. In the background, there is a crumbling domed structure. The sky has swirling clouds. The color scheme is monochrome, with browns and beiges. The painting technique emphasizes texture and contrasts. In the scene, there is a lone rider on a horse, a shepherd-like figure, and a small herd of sheep.

artworks.title: Jan Uytenbogaert, "The Goldweigher"
artworks.description: Two figures are presented in the image. The standing figure is behind a large table, reaching over it to hold the hands of the second figure who is kneeling beside a stack of goods. The standing person has light, shoulder-length hair and is wearing a fur coat and a hat. They are holding a quill and are surrounded by a ledger and goods. The kneeling figure is facing upwards towards the standing figure and is surrounded by barrels and a chest. The backdrop shows a room with a high ceiling, decorated with a tapestry and light shining in.

artworks.title: Two Standing Ladies (Demoiselles Quantin)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two women standing close together, embracing each other. Both women wear bonnets, long dresses, and cloaks. They have delicate facial features and are smiling slightly. The background is plain with shading for depth, and a signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Two Standing Ladies (Demoiselles Quantin)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing side by side with their arms around each other's shoulders. Both women have oval faces, delicate features, and are looking directly at the viewer with slight smiles. They are wearing long dresses with shawls draped over their shoulders, and their hair is covered by fabric headscarves. The image has a monochrome, sepia-toned appearance and the background is plain with no distinct features or objects.

artworks.title: Boating Party in an Underground Cave
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on wove paper, mounted on an album sheet with a separate engraved text plate
artworks.description: The image shows a subterranean scene within a cavern, with people gathered inside. The cavernous space dominates the composition, with rocky formations surrounding the figures. The horizon is not visible, as the scene is enclosed within a chamber, capturing the rock formations that recede into the cave's depths. The brushstrokes suggest meticulous detailing, emphasizing textures of the rock surfaces and light-play. The color palette consists of sepia tones, creating a warm, earthy atmosphere. A group of figures is depicted in the center, some illuminated by a fire. In the distance, a small boat with figures inside can be seen.
